# Golden Kitchen Garden Rwanda (GKG)

> Golden Kitchen Garden Rwanda Ltd (GKG) is a registered social enterprise based in Nkotsi, Musanze, Rwanda, founded in 2020 by Jean de Dieu Twagirimana. It promotes regenerative and climate-smart agriculture, nutrition and food security, kitchen and school gardens, circular-economy composting, edible landscaping, and income opportunities for women, youth, and persons with disabilities across Rwanda.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Golden Kitchen Garden Rwanda Ltd (RDB company code 112368548)
- Founded: 2020, by Jean de Dieu Twagirimana (Managing Director & Founder)
- Headquarters: Nkotsi, Musanze, Northern Province, Rwanda
- Website: https://goldenkitchengarden.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +250 788 206 976
- Email: info@goldenkitchengarden.com, customer@goldenkitchengarden.com
- Impact to date: 3,300+ women, youth and persons with disabilities empowered; 400+ modern kitchen gardens installed; 50+ VSLAs, 10 cooperatives and 11+ companies supported; 30+ school agriculture clubs established
- Vision 2030 targets: 12,000+ trained beneficiaries, 1,000+ kitchen gardens, 150 institutional partnerships
